title: Ketengban is a Trans-New Guinea language spoken in Highland...
text: Ketengban is a member of the Eastern Mek branch of the Trans-New Guinea language family. It is spoken by about 10,000 people in the east of Highland Papua Province in Indonesia near the border with Papua New Guinea.
